title: General Technical and Information Assistance
description: These prompts request practical help across a wide range of tasks, especially coding and troubleshooting, data extraction, explanations, translations, and drafting text.

title: Miscellaneous General Knowledge and Everyday Questions
description: These prompts cover a broad mix of unrelated requests for facts, recommendations, explanations, travel and food advice, and creative assistance.

title: AI Prompting, Roleplay, and Instruction-Following
description: These prompts give chatbots detailed roles, rules, formats, or task instructions, often testing prompt adherence and attempts to override the assistant’s constraints.

title: Writing, Editing, and Content Generation Requests
description: These prompts ask AI to draft, revise, summarize, explain, or structure content for a wide range of professional, academic, business, and social contexts.

title: Everyday Math, Logic, and Reasoning Questions
description: These prompts ask chatbots to solve or explain a varied set of arithmetic word problems, logic puzzles, riddles, and multiple-choice questions, often with step-by-step reasoning.

title: Explicit Erotica and Sexual Roleplay Requests
description: These prompts ask chatbots to generate, roleplay, or revise highly explicit sexual fiction, often using jailbreak-style instructions and themes involving coercion, taboo relationships, or other extreme scenarios.

title: General Knowledge and Writing Assistance
description: These prompts request explanations, summaries, examples, lists, and drafted or edited content across a wide range of academic, technical, and practical subjects.

title: Creative Writing and Story Generation
description: These prompts ask for original stories, poems, scripts, dialogue, and other imaginative writing, often with specific characters, genres, styles, or plot requirements.

title: Text Extraction and Structured NLP Tasks
description: These prompts ask AI to analyze text by extracting, classifying, summarizing, or transforming information into structured formats such as JSON, tables, and labels.

title: Generating Toxic Remarks for Everyday Situations
description: The prompts ask for brief toxic, harmful, or insulting statements tailored to varied interpersonal scenarios, often with demographic identity qualifiers.

title: Programming Help and Code Generation
description: These prompts primarily request code examples, scripts, tutorials, and technical guidance for building or understanding software across programming languages, frameworks, and platforms.

title: Python Programming Help and Code Examples
description: These prompts mostly request descriptive, example-driven guidance for common Python programming tasks, including data structures, strings, files, error handling, and pandas.

title: Questions About AI and Language Models
description: These prompts explore AI and large language models, including their capabilities, training, tools, applications, limitations, and development.

title: Questions and Creative Requests About Named Entities
description: These prompts ask for information, opinions, comparisons, or creative content involving people, fictional characters, places, products, and other named entities.

title: Chemical Industry Profiles of Specialty Compounds
description: The prompts request long-form articles about the production, synthesis, applications, safety, instructions, and upstream or downstream products of diverse specialty chemicals, especially heterocyclic and pharmaceutical intermediates.

title: Company Introductions for Chemical Businesses
description: The prompts request promotional, often lengthy introductions for named chemical, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and related companies, typically including their locations and industry context.

title: Python Coding Help and Examples
description: These prompts request help writing, explaining, debugging, refactoring, and extending Python code across algorithms, data analysis, machine learning, and applications.

title: Fact-Checking Summaries Against Source Documents
description: The prompts ask the model to judge whether summaries are factually consistent with provided documents or articles, often answering yes or no and explaining discrepancies.

title: Seed-Growing Conditions for Plant Species
description: Most prompts request concise environmental and soil requirements—such as temperature, humidity, sunlight, rainfall, climate, and water needs—for specific plant seeds.

title: Jailbreak Prompts for Harmful Content and GPT Definitions
description: Most prompts use fragmented string-concatenation framing to solicit toxic, abusive, or hateful statements, with a smaller group asking for brief explanations of GPT.
